dataset_provenance: condition-matched farmer records (5 estates, Jun-Sep 2026) with Open-Meteo weather; DRC/Metrolac values normalized by the dataset author; latex price derived from farm-gate levels (Jun-Sep 2026 levels estimated)
selection_basis: Cross-validation on the training partition (k-fold regression RMSE; stratified macro-F1 classification). The held-out test set is used once, in stage 31.
regression_accuracy_definition: Percentage of predictions whose absolute error falls within a declared tolerance (DRC +/-1.0 pp; price +/-LKR 5.0/kg of field latex). This is NOT accuracy and NOT R-squared.

candidates.regression: dummy_mean, linear_regression, random_forest, extra_trees, gradient_boosting, hist_gradient_boosting, xgboost (when installed), plus tuned shortlist
candidates.classification: dummy_most_frequent, logistic_regression, random_forest, extra_trees, gradient_boosting, xgboost (when installed), plus tuned shortlist

limitations: DRC values were normalized to Kudaligama chart entries by the dataset author; they are not original field measurements.
Price is derived as farm-gate latex price x DRC / 100, so a model with DRC as an input is close to relearning that formula; Jun-Sep 2026 farm-gate levels are estimates.
Collection-time prediction is excluded; no collection-time training data exists.
Rule-derived proxy labels from rainfall thresholds, judged on rain that actually fell; the model sees only the forecast issued beforehand (no added noise). NOT expert-verified tapping advice.
Only 5 estates and 4 months (Jun-Sep 2026) of farmer records; results may not hold for other estates or seasons.
The stored split is row-wise, so most test estates also appear in training; see the estate-grouped CV for the unseen-estate estimate.
Within-tolerance percentage is not the same as classification accuracy or R-squared.
